title: Haiyuan Earthquake
summary: A very large earthquake struck the Haiyuan area of eastern Gansu on the evening of 16 December 1920. It killed more than 200,000 people and badly damaged some 20,000 square kilometres, and about 200 km of surface faulting was seen. Its magnitude is given as 7.8 by the USGS and 8.5 by the Chinese Earthquake Administration.

uncertainty.note: Date as given by DisasterHistory.org (evening of 16 December); USGS lists it under 16 December 1920.

audience_note: Describes a natural disaster with very large loss of life.
